lines.vo: The habit that matters most isn't the workout. It's starting it.
That's not willpower. That's an instigation habit.
Dre plans the start in his Fit and Strong Tracker. Six p m, shoes on, out the door.

lines.vo: A study of about one hundred twenty adults split exercise habits into two parts.
Deciding to go on autopilot, and doing the workout itself on autopilot.
Only the automatic urge to start predicted how often people actually exercised.
So don't try to love every rep. Make the first two minutes automatic.
Same cue, same start. That's how you stay on track.

hook: The real habit is *starting* the workout
